front.title: The Cohort Layer of Post-Quantum Secure Transport (PQST)

abstract.t: This document specifies the cohort layer of Post-Quantum Secure Transport (PQST). With it, PQST provides independently migrating and recoverable post-quantum sessions within a persistent cohort authorization context. A cohort member's sessions move, sleep, recover and re-key on their own, and none of those events by itself requires a change of the cohort's membership. One sequencer commits the membership, the policy, and a membership epoch together with that epoch's key, and only on security events; members receive them inside their pairwise sessions, keep them through partitions, and return after dormancy or a restart without readmission, unless they were away longer than the group's expiry. This version specifies the group's control plane: membership, policy, reachability and member discovery. It describes, as the direction of the next version, a group data plane under keys derived from the epoch key, which would give the members one secure session among themselves.
